children.title: Heredity Thresholds and Stoichiometric Conditions in Prebiotic Chemical Systems

detail.title: Heredity Thresholds and Stoichiometric Conditions in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
detail.summary: This revision integrates thermodynamic constraints and stoichiometric submatrix criteria to define the threshold between persistent chemical states and true heredity.
detail.reason: Revision incorporates new thermodynamic bounds and formalizes the distinction between persistent states and Darwinian heredity based on current literature.
